notes.title: Australia, win a Wolfenstein: The New Order Panzerhund Edition
notes.content:
What's better than shooting Nazis in the face via the medium of computer games? Shooting Nazis in the face while surrounded by fancy merchandise related to a game about shooting Nazis in the face, that's what.

Thanks to Bethesda and MachineGames we're offering Australian readers the chance to win a limited edition Wolfenstein: The New Order Panzerhund Edition pack worth $110. The pack doesn't include the game, but it does include such fancy materials as an 8 inch "fully articulated hand-painted Panzerhund statue and base", as well as:

- A classified folder containing salvaged secret war documents including maps, case files, letters, secret documents, blueprints and an x-ray for the game s hero, B.J. Blazkowicz.

- A set of 14 full-color vintage postcards from Wolfenstein s alternate 1960 s, bound in a display book.

- Three embroidered patches and a replica dog tag.

- An exclusive Steelbook case to house your copy of the game

Here's what you're getting in pictorial format:



We also have three merch packs up for grabs, including a shirt, bag and poster. To go in the draw, you'll need to visit the competition page and answer the following question: What would you ask Wolfenstein protagonist BJ Blazkowicz if he was a real life person?

Entries close next Friday, May 30. The competition is open to Australian residents only.

notes.title: Wolfenstein: The New Order PC Support
notes.content:
[b][u]The game stops running shortly after I launch the game.[/u][/b]
Make sure you have installed and are running the latest video card drivers.  
 
[b][u]I get stuck on a black screen when I launch the game.[/u][/b]
A possible workaround for this issue is to launch the game executable as an administrator.  To do this, make sure you are logged in as the system admin, the right-click on the executable and select “Run as Admin”.
 
[b][u]Does the game support SLI or Crossfire dual GPUs?[/u][/b]
No.  For best performance, it is recommended that you disable these modes. If you to try running in either mode at your own risk and make sure you have installed the latest drivers.
 
[b][u]I’m getting stuttering/framerate issues + artifacting in fullscreen/fullscreen-windowed mode.[/u][/b]
Try turning off triple buffering in your driver settings (via the Catalyst control center [for AMD GPUs] or the NVIDIA control panel [for NVIDIA GPUs]. If you continue to experience performance issues, you might want to try the following as well:
[list]
[*]Setting V-Sync to “Use 3D application setting” in the NVIDIA control panel (NVIDIA only)
[*]Disabling V-sync in the game’s Advanced Video Settings
[*]Turn off Screen Space Reflections in the game’s Advanced Video Settings
[*]Set Shadow Resolution to lowest in the game’s Advanced Video Settings
[/list]
[b][u]I’ve installed the disc-based version of the PC game.  Do I need to install the ~10GB path?[/u][/b]
Yes. This additional content must be installed to play the game.
 
[b][u]I’ve installed the latest video card drivers as recommended, but I’m still experiencing issues.[/u][/b]
Make sure you restart your computer after installing new drivers before you play the game again.  If issues persist, please contact support.bethsoft.com.
 
[b][u]I have an above-spec NVIDIA card and V-SYNC is not working. [/u][/b]
A potential workaround for this is to force V-SYNC in the NVIDIA control panel by selecting “Use 3D application setting”.
 
[b][u]Where can I get FAQs for Wolfenstein: The New Order?[/u][/b]
You can receive support for the game by visiting support.bethsoft.com.
 
[b][u]What are the required PC specifications [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]64-bit Windows 7/Windows 8
[*]Intel Core i7 or equivalent AMD (FX 6300)
[*]4 GB System RAM
[*]50 GB free HDD space
[*]GeForce 460, ATI Radeon HD 6850
[*]High Speed Internet Connection
[*]Steam account and activation required
[/list]
[b][u]What drivers should I be using to run Wolfenstein? [/u][/b]
[list]
[*]For NVIDIA – Geforce 335.23
[*]For AMD – Catalyst 14.4
[/list]
